references.text: In this earlier meeting, the Jews also attempt to stone Jesus, but he escapes them by hiding and leaving the temple.
The disciples remind Jesus that the Jews recently tried to stone him, illustrating the recurring threat of stoning.
The chief priests and Pharisees have ordered that anyone who knows where Jesus is must report it, so they can arrest and stone him.
The psalm describes the stone that the builders rejected, a picture of Jesus being rejected and attacked by the leaders.
